description: issue #674 (SP2): with the `sprites` profile active, a `tell` statement parses AND checks clean — the checker's unknown-command rule recognizes `tell` as a visible command name because `collectVisibleNames` registers the Sprites statement form under an active `sprites` profile (the other half of the slice: a form that only parses would still be rejected `ol-unknown-command`). The `:x = 1` assignment defines `:x` so the argument is not `ol-undefined-var`.
